title: ScottTrivia
description: A lightweight and highly customizable trivia quiz plugin for Minecraft servers.
body:
# ScottTrivia 

A lightweight, highly customizable trivia plugin for modern Paper servers. ScottTrivia
runs interactive quiz events — scheduled or manual — where players answer questions in
chat, build answer streaks, climb a per-session leaderboard, and earn rewards.

## Requirements
- This download includes TWO jars — ScottTrivia and ScottAPI. Put BOTH in your /plugins folder.
- ScottAPI is required; ScottTrivia will not load without it. It also powers the multi-language
  system (messages, question content, and reward names).
- Vault is optional — only needed for economy (money) rewards. Command-based rewards work without it.
- Built for Paper 1.21+ (api-version 1.21), Java 21.

## Features

- Automatic scheduled trivia sessions (configurable interval) plus manual start/stop.
- Configurable questions per session — set 1 for single-question rounds or any number
  for multi-question sessions.
- Flexible answer matching: case-insensitive and space-trimming options, plus multiple
  accepted answers (aliases) per question.
- Per-session scoring with a live leaderboard, plus persistent per-player all-time score
  and correct-answer totals.
- Single-session win-streak tracking with milestone rewards (e.g. 3 / 5 / 10 in a row).
- Layered reward system:
  - per correct answer,
  - ranked session-end rewards (1st / 2nd / 3rd) with an optional participation reward
    for everyone meeting a minimum correct-answer count,
  - win-streak milestones.
  Each reward can pay out via Vault economy and/or run console commands (give items,
  run titles, etc.), with optional broadcast.
- Multi-language support via ScottAPI/ScottLang. Messages, question text/answers/aliases,
  and reward names live in editable `lang/scottrivia/<lang>.yml` files (bundled: en_US,
  zh_TW). A fallback message block in config.yml is used only when ScottLang is absent.
- Player data tracking with an answer cooldown and a configurable max-winners-per-question
  cap to limit spam and abuse.
- Lightweight and optimized for Paper (uses the modern Paper chat event).

## Use cases

- Server-wide quiz events
- Community engagement activities
- Mini-game systems
- Reward-based interactive gameplay

## Commands

- `/trivia start` — start a session
- `/trivia stop` — stop the current session
- `/trivia reload` — reload configuration
- `/trivia force` — force the next action
- `/trivia skip` — skip the current question
- `/trivia score` — show your score
- `/trivia help` — show command help
- `/triviaadmin <start|stop|reload|force|skip>` — admin controls

## Permissions

- `scottrivia.use` — use `/trivia` (default: all players)
- `scottrivia.admin` — use `/triviaadmin` (default: op)

ScottTrivia is actively maintained and intended for stable production use.

# ScottTrivia（繁體中文）

一個輕量、高度可自訂的問答插件,專為現代 Paper 伺服器設計。ScottTrivia 可進行
定時或手動的問答活動:玩家在聊天室搶答、累積連勝、登上單場排行榜並獲得獎勵。

## 安裝需求
- 本下載包含「兩個」jar —— ScottTrivia 與 ScottAPI,請把兩個都放進 /plugins 資料夾。
- ScottAPI 為必需,未安裝 ScottTrivia 將無法載入;多語言系統(訊息、題目內容、獎勵名稱)也由它提供。
- Vault 為選用,僅在啟用經濟(金錢)獎勵時需要;指令型獎勵不需 Vault 即可運作。
- 適用 Paper 1.21+(api-version 1.21),Java 21。

## 功能特色

- 定時自動問答場次(間隔可設定),並支援手動開始/停止。
- 每場題數可設定 —— 設為 1 即單題模式,設為 N 即多題模式。
- 彈性的答案比對:可選忽略大小寫與去除空白,並支援每題多個可接受答案(別名)。
- 單場計分與即時排行榜,另有逐玩家的歷史總分與答對題數累計(持久化)。
- 單場連勝追蹤與里程碑獎勵(例如 3 / 5 / 10 連勝)。
- 分層獎勵系統:
  - 答對單題獎勵,
  - 場次結束依排名發獎(第 1 / 2 / 3 名),並可對「達到最低答對題數」的玩家發放參與安慰獎,
  - 連勝里程碑獎勵。
  每種獎勵都可透過 Vault 經濟發放,與/或執行主控台指令(發物品、下稱號等),並可選擇是否全服廣播。
- 多語言由 ScottAPI/ScottLang 提供。訊息、題目(題目/答案/別名)與獎勵名稱皆放在可編輯的
  `lang/scottrivia/<lang>.yml`(內建 en_US、zh_TW);僅在沒有 ScottLang 時,才使用 config.yml
  內的 fallback 訊息區段。
- 玩家資料紀錄,搭配答題冷卻與「每題最多得獎人數」上限設定,降低洗版與濫用。
- 輕量、針對 Paper 優化(使用 Paper 現代聊天事件)。

## 適用場景

- 伺服器活動問答
- 社群互動活動
- 小遊戲系統
- 獎勵型互動玩法

## 指令

- `/trivia start` — 開始一場問答
- `/trivia stop` — 停止目前場次
- `/trivia reload` — 重新載入設定
- `/trivia force` — 強制執行下一步
- `/trivia skip` — 跳過目前題目
- `/trivia score` — 查看自己的分數
- `/trivia help` — 顯示指令說明
- `/triviaadmin <start|stop|reload|force|skip>` — 管理員控制指令

## 權限

- `scottrivia.use` — 使用 `/trivia`(預設:所有玩家)
- `scottrivia.admin` — 使用 `/triviaadmin`(預設:OP)

ScottTrivia 持續維護中,可用於穩定的正式環境。---
